This analysis changes label-source corroboration to existing raw supervised/PL anchors, not a retuned G or graph gate.
All three classifiers use their original jointly trained default heads. No averaging of model weights, new head fitting or runtime ensemble performance claim.
Common source data/initialization means agreement is correlated; source precision must be measured, never inferred from agreement.
Existing source V has already informed development; this is not an independent blind benchmark.
If neither passes, retain both negative outcomes and do not train students with them. Passing here never replaces actual three-seed raw/G target validation.
